title: ‘Beatles’ Films Release Details: A Mega-Month of Movie-Going, Producers Hope
full_text: × Skip to main content By Lily Ford Plus Icon Lily Ford @lilyfordtweets Follow Sign Up View All October 12, 2026 8:53am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Paul Mescal as Paul McCartney in Sony's Beatles biopics. Courtesy of Sony More intel on Sony ‘s distribution plan for Sam Mendes ‘ hotly anticipated Beatles films has arrived. Paul Mescal , Harris Dickinson , Joseph Quinn and Barry Keoghan will play Paul McCartney, John Lennon, George Harrison and Ringo Starr , respectively, with the four features currently slated to release in the same month in 2028. Internet-savvy fans will have noticed a swathe of social media videos of the actors in costume filming around London over the last few months. For example, in August, they were spotted re-creating the group’s iconic Abbey Road album cover . The original photo, taken on Aug. 8, 1969, features the Fab Four walking in single file across a crosswalk outside EMI Studios in London. Related Stories Movies Ava DuVernay Says That '14th' Saved Her and "Hollywood Is Over" TV Rakuten TV Launching in U.S., Japan, Middle East (Exclusive) On Monday, Mendes’ long-time producing partner, co-founder of the pair’s Neal Street Productions, Pippa Harris , sat for a keynote session at the BFI London Film Festival’s Industry Forum. She provided a coy update on the rollout, currently described as a “four-film cinematic event” across the month of April. Harris — who came from set to make her Industry Forum appearance for just an hour before heading back — said the team is currently on day 180 of the shoot. She responded later in the session when asked for more details on the distribution plan: “The idea at the moment is the films will come out in 2028, and we want people to be able to experience them in the cinema during the same period.” She clarified: “That doesn’t necessarily mean we’re thinking that people will go and see all four films on the same day. But within the same month, you might see one a week, or you might see one on a weekend, two the next one. However you see it, I think our hope is that people will see all four films,” she continued. “They stand alone as individual stories of each of those four men, but they have a cumulative power, which I think is greater than the sum of their parts. The Beatles are, I think, the greatest band in history, and we’re trying to do our best to do them justice. Hence the four films. I don’t think there’s probably another band that you could legitimately say you wanted to see four films for,” she added. Earlier in the session, she jokingly revealed that the cast members have been explicitly told not to talk about the top-secret movies on various red carpets. “It’s a big endeavor,” said Harris. Also in the Beatles films, Mia McKenna-Bruce stars as Maureen Cox, the wife of Ringo Starr; Anna Sawai will be Yoko Ono, John Lennon’s wife; and Aimee Lou Wood will be Pattie Boyd, who married George Harrison. Saoirse Ronan plays Linda (Eastman) McCartney. Prolific producer Harris is a titan of the British film and TV industry and has worked for decades on some of the most popular shows and films the country has ever produced. Among them are Hamnet , 1917 and Call the Midwife . She went into depth about her wide-ranging career with radio presenter Edith Bowman on Monday, where she reflected on an array of iconic projects, her advice for aspiring producers in the room and why she hasn’t picked up that well-earned Oscar yet. The 70th BFI London Film Festival runs Oct. 7-18. THR

title: Journalist Natalie Morales Joins Flow Space Women’s Health Summit in Los Angeles

Flow Space, SHE Media’s digital and live media platform dedicated to women’s health, announced the news Monday. Morales, who has spoken publicly about her family’s experience with Alzheimer’s disease and the importance of awareness, joins a lineup of leading experts, advocates and innovators for the one-day event. The summit will explore the latest research and help separate the science from the hype around some of the most pressing issues in women’s health today. title: Dan Levy Slams Shane Gillis’ ‘SNL’ Joke About Women at the Gym: “Speechless That Can Exist”
full_text: Skip to main content By James Hibberd Plus Icon James Hibberd Writer-at-Large JamesHibberd Follow Sign Up View All October 12, 2026 8:30am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Shane Gillis on 'Saturday Night Live.' Screenshot. Logo text A joke from Shane Gillis ‘ Saturday Night Live monologue is drawing fire from Schitt’s Creek co-creator and star Dan Levy . Gillis — the popular stand-up comedian who also stars in Netflix’s Tires — hosted SNL this weekend and delivered this joke during his opening set (watch it below): “I haven’t been to the gym in so long, I didn’t know women just dress like whores now. Look, I’m sorry, there’s no other way to describe [it]. Have you seen it? I’ve seen it. The shorts? Have you seen the shorts? They’re neon, like, artificial bait-colored? And the wrinkles go around the cheeks and all combine at the butthole. And don’t look. You’re not allowed to look. For real, don’t look, because they are filming. I’m in the background of like 10 TikToks right now.” Related Stories TV 'SNL': Shane Gillis Shares "Gas Station Egg" Nickname From Joe Rogan, Pete Hegseth Celebrates USS Lincoln San Diego Homecoming TV Taylor Swift Crashes Dakota Johnson's 'Saturday Night Live' Hosting Stint: "My Literal Therapist!" In response, Levy posted the following on Instagram on Sunday: “Women wearing short shorts at the gym does not make them whores. It makes the men calling them whores misogynists. There’s a difference there. By the way, I’ve seen more men’s nipples at the gym than I’ve ever seen women showing their bodies off.” Continued the Canadian actor: “But I’m speechless that something like that can exist on live national television. And to be perfectly honest, more men need to be standing up in opposition to it because it’s complacency that has created the environment in which women are sexually assaulted and it’s a ‘conversation’ as opposed to a ‘crime.'” “Men need to be defending women more. This is not a women’s issue, this is an everybody issue. Because the more that men objectify women in the media, the more that other men see them as objects and treat them as objects. They are not objects. They are superior human beings to men, OK? And I’m sorry if this gets me in trouble with the internet, but fuck.” Gillis also drew some criticism for unintentionally saying the F-word during a sketch on SNL , and Gillis subsequently apologized. The stand-up has a long and unique history with the NBC series, having been hired as a cast member in 2019 then quickly fired before he could start the season due to resurfaced comments he made on podcasts. Gillis’ stand-up career then took off, and he hosted the series in 2024 and 2025. THR

full_text: Skip to main content By Dominic Patten Dominic Patten Executive Editor, Legal, Labor & Politics @DeadlineDominic More Stories By Dominic Disney’s Former Top IP Lawyer Sues House Of Mouse For Ageism & Wrongful Termination: “Sleepless Nights & Days” Skydance CEOs Pressed On Layoffs & Donald Trump Interference As They Outline Future At Town Hall ‘SNL’ Cold Open Goes Full MAGA Midterms Desperation With Hegseth’s “Schlong Donkeys”, Trump’s Rambles & A Sad VP View All October 1, 2026 3:09pm Add us as a Google Preferred Source Sean "Diddy" Combs Getty Images Sean “Diddy” Combs’ sweet ride behind bars has come to an end. No official word has come down yet from the federal Bureau of Prisons in response to a NBC News segment this week revealing the Bad Boy Records founder has been using banned cellphones, allegedly smuggling in booze and having a paid for a de facto posse and cleaning staff during his incarceration. However, sources tell me authorities at FCI Fort Dix that Combs’ actions will have “serious consequences.” Among them, Combs has now been placed in solitary confinement at the low-security New Jersey facility. Related Stories News DOJ Launches Investigation Of Networks For Suspending TV Pool Amid Trump's Ban On CNN News 'Walker' & 'Pretty Little Liars' Actor Keegan Allen Pistol-Whipped And Robbed In West Hollywood Convicted of two counts of transportation to engage in prostitution in July 2025 and sentenced to a 50-month stint (with time served ), Combs was moved out of the prison’s general population late Wednesday, I hear. How long Combs will stay in the hole is TBD, but also under consideration is pushing back the Grammy winner’s early 2028 release date. After several shifts in Combs’ release date in part due to his participation in a drug treatment program, he most recently saw his date moved up to January 21, 2028 from the date of May 8, 2028 date he had when he entered Fort Dix. That date was a far cry from the June 4, 2028 date he was assigned in November of last year. Now, because of the violations revealed on camera by NBC, Combs could be looking at months being re-added. The BOP had no specific comments on Combs or the images and reports of his champagne lifestyle behind bars but told Deadline: “Like all correctional agencies, contraband, particularly cell phones, narcotics, and weapons, remains a constant challenge, and we continue to tackle the problem of contraband being introduced into our facilities. Inmates are not permitted to have access to cell phones, and all incarcerated individuals in the Federal Bureau of Prisons (BOP) who are found to violate the ‘Inmate Discipline Program’ policy are subject to sanctions.” All of this would be moot if Combs received the pardon he begged Donald Trump for, or if NYC jurors last year had found Combs guilty of racketeering conspiracy and sex trafficking charges, as prosecutors in the high-turnover Southern District of New York’s U.S. Attorney’s Office had hoped. That verdict in the 2025 trial over filmed sex parties and freak-offs, Cassie Ventura beatings, drug binges, threats, exploding cars and allegedly hanging people off balconies, would have seen Combs, 56, receive a life sentence behind bars. Combs’ rep Juda Engelmayer on Thursday had nothing to say about the once mini-mogul being in solitary or a possible delay in his release from prison, but he certainly had questions about who should be getting punished, who else is in the wrong and how. “There is something odd about all of this. Someone was apparently able to record Sean inside the prison, and numerous stories continue to emerge from inside the facility in real time,” the crisis communications veteran told Deadline. “Yet the focus inevitably lands on the celebrity because he is the person everyone recognizes. There are legitimate questions about how recordings and information are making their way out of a federal prison in the first place. Focusing almost exclusively on the famous inmate may make the easiest headline, but it overlooks the broader question of how this material is being obtained and circulated.” As Combs’ East Coast case is in the middle of a fast-tracked appeal, the L.A. County District Attorney’s office still has a LAPD sexual battery report on him “under review,” a spokesperson for Nathan Hochman ‘s team tells Deadline. Handed over to the DA in late 2025 , the LAPD case concerns music producer Jonathan Hay. Last November, the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department confirmed a probe had been opened into Hay’s claims of sexual battery by Combs against him in L.A. in 2020. Co-written by Fuchs and Waldron, in Spaceship Earth, when a mission to avert an imminent global cataclysm goes awry, a small band of teenagers from Earth’s past and future must join forces to confront a threat as vast and mysterious as time itself. Fuchs serves as executive producer and showrunner, with Waldron also executive producing via his Anomaly Pictures banner. Lee Toland Krieger ( You, Riverdale, Shadow & Bone ) directs and executive produces the pilot along with Adam Fishbach via his Fishbach Productions, and Adam Fasullo. 20th Television is the studio. Related Stories News Disney+ Hires Amazon's Philip Pratt To Run Originals In Germany, Switzerland & Austria Books 'Artemis Fowl' Animated Series Greenlit At Disney Channel, Disney+ With Author Eoin Colfer As EP -- NYCC The Spaceship Earth attraction is housed in the geodesic sphere at Walt Disney World in Bay Lake, Florida, which has served as the symbolic structure of EPCOT since the park opened in 1982. The 15-minute ride takes guests on a time machine-themed experience, demonstrating how advancements in human communication have helped to create the future one step at a time. Watch on Deadline Fuchs most recently co-created, co-showran and executive produced HBO’s IT: Welcome To Derry . He’s currently writing a live-action feature adaptation of My Hero Academia for Netflix and Legendary’ and is writing the new Transformers script for Paramount and Hasbro. Fuchs just launched his own company, Five Ten Productions, with his wife, producer, and actress Alixandra Fuchs. He is repped by WME and attorney Michael Schenkman at Goodman, Genow, Schenkman, Smelkinson & Christopher. Waldron created, served as head writer, and executive produced Marvel and Disney+’s hit series Loki and wrote Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness for director Sam Raimi. Next up, he is the co-writer of Avengers: Doomsday which hits theaters in December 2026. Waldron is repped by CAA, Untitled Entertainment and attorney Michael Shenkman at Shenkman Law. Krieger, known for his work on You, Deadly Class, Shadow and Bone, Superman & Lois, among others, recently wrapped the Netflix feature Picture It, starring Millie Bobby Brown and Gabriel LaBelle. His features include The Age of Adeline starring Blake Lively, Harrison Ford and Ellen Burstyn, and romantic comedy-drama Celeste & Jesse Forever. He’s repped by UTA and Davis Law Group. Fishbach has been under an overall with 20th Television for the past four years. His work past work with Disney includes the Hulu series Love, Victor, The Other Black Girl, and La Máquina and the Disney+ film A Very Jonas Christmas Movie for Disney+. He previously was an Executive Producer on Netflix’s Narcos, Narcos: Mexic o, and F Is for Family and the hit feature Smile. title: Monarch Media To Produce First-Time Feature Scribe Jonathan Yu’s Coming-Of-Age Dramedy ‘Goldfish’
full_text: Skip to main content By Matt Grobar Matt Grobar Senior Film Reporter More Stories By Matt Catherine Laga’aia & Deacon Phillippe To Lead Disney+ Pilot ‘Spaceship Earth’ Craig Zobel & Blumhouse Teaming On ‘Something Is Killing The Children’ ‘All The Little Houses’ Series Adaptation In The Works At Apple From ‘The Hunting Wives’ Author May Cobb, Naomi Sheldon & Fifth Season View All October 12, 2026 11:50am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Jonathan Yu Courtesy EXCLUSIVE: In his first outing as screenwriter, Jonathan Yu is already on his way toward a produced script: Monarch Media has announced that it will be producing his coming-of-age feature dramedy, Goldfish . Goldfish centers on a 17-year-old high school senior who presents as detached, ironic and emotionally armored, but underneath is quietly paralyzed by fear of failure, abandonment and becoming his parents. Set to produce for Monarch, Steve Barnett, Alan Powell and Vicky Patel are currently in search of a director for the project. Related Stories News Kali Bailey Adapting L. Frank Baum's 'The Life And Adventures Of Santa Claus' For Monarch Media Casting Nick Jonas Set For New Netflix Rom-Com From Director Ari Sandel Patel, who was contacted by Yu via cold-email, was immediately hooked after reading his script and brought it to her colleagues, leading to traction on the film. Watch on Deadline “Every once in a great while, you pick up a wholly original coming-of-age script that’s filled with humor, heart and teenage angst, and this is one of those screenplays,” Patel said. “Jonathan has done an incredible job of crafting a story we can all relate to, and we can’t wait to bring it to life.” A human biology major at UC San Diego, Yu has had a love of storytelling ever since discovering the Harry Potter books, and films like Jurassic Park and Good Will Hunting , early in life. He didn’t come to recognize that screenwriting could be a career option until well into college. While Goldfish is not autobiographical, the script draws on his years on his high school swim team. He is repped by 831 Entertainment. Monarch Media is best known for its work on the acclaimed Richard Linklater film Hit Man , starring Glen Powell. The company’s adult animated feature film Tangles , starring Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Seth Rogen and Bryan Cranston, is vying for Oscar consideration after premiering to critical acclaim at Cannes. More recently, the company launched its comedy Babies , starring Rogen and Anna Kendrick, out of the Toronto Film Festival earlier this month.
